messages:
chris_cust: Hi team — our integration started failing this morning when calling the 'order_lookup' tool via function-calling. Getting a schema validation error. Can someone help?

jess_support: Sorry about that, chris. Can you paste the exact request payload + the API/method you used? If possible, include a curl snippet.

support-bot: :rotating_light: New support ticket created: #SR-2391 — assigned to jess_support.

chris_cust: here's redacted curl (we replaced API key):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call \  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxx" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"tool":"order_lookup","args":{"order_id":"12345","session":"a1b2c3","include_items":true}}'
```
Response:
```
{ "error": "tool_schema_validation_failed", "details": "required property 'order_id' is missing or type mismatch; additionalProperties not allowed: session" }
```

jess_support: Thanks. Two quick things to check: 1) In our tool schemas order_id is expected to be an integer (not a string). 2) The tool schema disallows extra root props under args like `session`. Looks like your client is including that. Can you confirm the type of order_id in your client?

chris_cust: ah — our mobile SDK serializes numbers as strings for IDs in some endpoints. We just rolled out a change last night. Also we send a `session` token so we can trace user context.

ravi_eng-ml: Reproduced in sandbox. Running the same payload against the function-caller validates against the registered JSON Schema for 'order_lookup' and rejects it. Here's the validation log snippet:
```
2026-02-11T09:02:12Z function-caller validation ERROR: /args/order_id: expected integer but got string
ValidationError: additionalProperties ["session"] not allowed at /args
```

lina_sre: Any latency/errors in the runtime or schema service around that timestamp? I checked infra dashboards — no rollout or schema service deploy during the window. This looks like a client-side payload mismatch.

jess_support: Options: 1) Client fixes: send order_id as number and drop session from args. 2) Short-term: we can relax schema to allow additionalProperties or add `session` as optional string in tool schema. 3) We can coerce in gateway to accept string IDs and parse them — but that changes behavior across customers.

chris_cust: We need a low-friction workaround; difficult to push a mobile SDK patch immediately. Would option 3 (coercion) be feasible just for our org? We're on Dedicated plan and can accept the slight risk.

ravi_eng-ml: We can add a per-organization request transform rule on Dedicated to coerce numeric strings to integers for specific routes. Implementation notes: small middleware that tries Number(value) when schema expects integer and the value is a numeric string. Will need an explicit opt-in flag on your org config.

jess_support: I can open an internal change request. Quick repro steps for engineering recorded: 1) POST payload as chris did to sandbox 2) observe 400 with schema validation details 3) apply middleware with coercion and re-run -> 200 + tool response.

chris_cust: That works for us. Do you need anything else from our side?

support-bot: Note: SR-2391 updated — engineering task created: ENG-4927 (add org-level arg coercion middleware).

ravi_eng-ml: Will sketch the PR and config flag today. Also recommending a longer-term fix: add an optional `context` object to the tool schema so customers can pass arbitrary tracing info without hitting additionalProperties. Short schema patch: add "context": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": true } to args with docs saying it's for tracing only.

jess_support: Sounds good. I'll send a scoped support agreement for the Dedicated opt-in and timeline. chris_cust, thanks for the quick repro — saved us a lot of triage time. :white_check_mark:

chris_cust: Thanks everyone. We'll wait for the opt-in config and patch. Appreciate it! :pray:
